sentences.text: Heard Ms. Vanlalsawmi, learned counsel for the petitioner.

Also heard Ms. Zairemsangpuii, learned 1 & 2; and Ms. Lalnunhlui, learned Government Advocate, appearing on behalf of respondents No. 3 & 4.
2.

By way of filing this petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India; the petitioner seeks for a direction to the respondents to pay interest payable to him from the date of taking possession of the acquired land till the date of payment of awarded compensation in terms of Section 34 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

Page No.# 2/2 3. Issue notice, returnable within 4(four) weeks.
4. Since Ms. Zairemsangpuii, learned CGC, and Ms. Lalnunhlui, learned Government Advocate,
have appeared and accepted notice on behalf of their respective respondents, no formal notice is required to be sent to the said respondents.
5. List it after 4(four) weeks on a date to be fixed by the Registry.
